rule: Representative irregular development sample, fixed before any candidate is read: (A) every irregular family of E13's development collection (20; drawn by E13's declared pattern sampler from fresh pools, judged once on E11 greedy and one canonical-beam alternative); (B) every word of E11's 40-word representative dev review that meets E06's registered difficulty rule (e06.is_difficult on the first CMUdict reading); E11's 20-word disagreement sample is failure-enriched and excluded; (C) 6 further historical-dev families meeting the same rule, unambiguous in CMUdict, outside every E11 review word and every E12/E13 test and E13 collection family, in seeded order (sha256 of 'e11-coverage-v1:<word>'). Nothing is selected from test sets or from model failures.

generation.candidates: E11 greedy + up to 4 distinct canonical-beam candidates, the same limit for every word; no other model

budget.reduction: if the worst case exceeded the cap, pool C would shrink from the end before generation (not needed)

purpose: diagnostic: does E11 already generate acceptable alternatives for irregular dev words but rank them poorly? Not a release gate and not evidence that a ranker would succeed.
metrics: ≥ 1 confirmed-acceptable candidate among the 4 beam candidates
words recoverable by choosing another candidate (greedy not confirmed acceptable, another candidate confirmed acceptable)
